requires.degrade: Without node, the session-flow hooks cannot launch, so they do nothing.

Without jq, the session-flow hooks skip their work, fetch-docs.sh exits before reading anything so /session-flow:retro reads a docs page with WebFetch instead, and /session-flow:retro codify reviews cannot read review comments.

Without gh, /session-flow:retro codify reviews cannot read pull request review comments; every other retro mode and codify input still works. /session-flow:recall skips closed unmerged pull requests and says so.

Without Python 3.10+, /session-flow:find-handoff lists only transcript directories whose name matches a worktree exactly, so sessions started in a subdirectory or stored under a hashed long name are not scanned, and it says so. /session-flow:recall cannot scan transcripts and reports from git, pull requests and the tracker alone. /session-flow:retro skips transcript metrics. Without any Python 3, a docs page that serves only HTML cannot be converted and is recorded unread with reason no-python; pages served as markdown read normally.
Without git, /session-flow:recall cannot search commit history for reverted attempts and says so; its transcript, pull request and tracker sources still work.
Without curl, fetch-docs.sh records a docs page unread with reason curl-missing, so /session-flow:retro reads it with WebFetch instead.
